articles.headline: Collin Dixon's 2 TD catches help Illinois become bowl eligible with 24-13 victory over Nebraska
articles.description: — Collin Dixon caught two touchdown passes including a record-breaker and Illinois used a trick play to set up its go-ahead TD as the Illini defeated Nebraska 24-13 on Friday night to become bowl eligible with their fourth straight victory.

article.story: West Virginia (5-3) at No. 13 Texas Tech (7-1), Nov. 7 at 9:30 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Texas Tech by 16.5. Against the spread: Texas Tech 4-4, West Virginia 4-3-1. Texas Tech is 116th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:14, while West Virginia's 118th-ranked average is 28:02. Hawkins led West Virginia with 79 yards on 7-of-15 passing (46.7%) for one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball 20 times for 87 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Cook had 90 rushing yards on 18 carries, adding one reception for 13 yards and one touchdown. Prince Strachan put up 24 yards on two catches. Next game Texas Tech plays at Oklahoma State on Nov. 14.
